chapters.title: Chapter 1: How Our Farmers are Hobbled
Chapter 4: Why MSPs are a Problem

episode.tagline: India's farmers are suffering. Indian agriculture has been in crisis since we gained Independence. Why? What can we do about it?
episode.about: In this episode, Amit and Ajay discuss the many complicated problems of Indian agriculture, breaking them down one by one. Spoiler alert: the oppressive hand of the state is at the heart of it all. Us city slickers take some of our freedoms for granted -- but our farmers are still denied basic liberties. It's a tragedy.
